headline: On November 3, 1976: Carrie premieres in 17 theaters
captionCards: Carrie premiered in 17 theaters in D.C.-Baltimore area
Set a new standard for horror and high school drama
instagramCaption:
Carrie, a supernatural horror film, hits the big screen. \\[Brian De Palma directed the film, based on Stephen King's novel, starring Sissy Spacek as a bullied teen with telekinetic powers. The film also featured Piper Laurie, Amy Irving, and John Travolta. It was the first in the Carrie franchise. \\The film's blend of horror and high school drama set a new standard for the genre. \\What's your favorite scene from Carrie? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
